name: io.github.tonyyang0504/prodigi-mcp
description: Prodigi (ecommerce suppliers): me, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool maps to a docume

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prodigi API key for the LIVE environment (dashboard), sent as `X-API-Key`. A Sandbox key needs PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_ENV=sandbox (https://api.sandbox.prodigi.com/v4.0).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://api.sandbox.prodigi.com/v4.0. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODIGI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
